errors.text_span: Общият брой на включените сектори е шест.
errors.evidence: The chart clearly shows seven sectors for seven different age groups (14-17, 18-24, 25-34, 35-44, 45-54, 55-64, 65+), not six.

errors.text_span: Секторът, обозначен като „14-17“, е син и представлява 14% от общата сума.
errors.evidence: The sector for the '14-17' age group represents 5% of the total, not 14%. The 14% value corresponds to the '65+' age group.

errors.text_span: Секторът „18-24“ е оранжев и представлява 5% от общата сума.
errors.evidence: The sector for the '18-24' age group represents 13% of the total, not 5%. The 5% value corresponds to the '14-17' age group.
The sector for the '25-34' age group represents 20% of the total, not 13%. The 13% value corresponds to the '18-24' age group.

errors.text_span: Секторът „45-54“ е зелен и представлява 15% от общата сума.
errors.evidence: The sector for the '45-54' age group is light blue and represents 16%, not green and 15%. The green sector with 15% corresponds to the '55-64' age group.

errors.text_span: Секторът „55-64“ е светло сив и представлява 20%,
errors.evidence: The sector for the '55-64' age group is green and represents 15%, not light grey and 20%. The light grey sector with 20% corresponds to the '25-34' age group.
The sector for the '65+' age group is dark blue and represents 14%, not black and 16%. The sector with 16% corresponds to the '45-54' age group.

errors.text_span: Секторите изглеждат сортирани по низходящ размер, започвайки от светло сив и продължавайки по посока на часовниковата стрелка.
errors.evidence: The sectors are not sorted in any particular order. Following the slices clockwise from the largest one (20%), the values are 17%, 16%, 15%, 14%, 5%, 13%, which is not a descending order.
